claims.claim: French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu will meet representatives of employers' organisations and private-sector unions on November 9 to address cost-of-living concerns.
claims.episode_span: French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu will meet representatives of employers' organisations and private-sector unions on November 9 to address cost-of-living concerns.
claims.source_title: French PM Lecornu holds talks over protesters' cost-of-living concerns
